text:
Sam: FYI posted the IO cache eviction postmortem and the recurrence notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026. TL;DR: repeated small write spikes lead to broad KV evictions -> P99 tail blips. Need follow-ups turned into tests and owners.

Priya: Agreed. We should split into: deterministic replay regression, sustained load that ramps working set, promptset/eval additions, and a chaos run. Who takes what?

Marta: I can take the regression harness. Plan is to implement a replay runner + a stress scenario that toggles cache pressure. Aim: PR with tests + local README, then nightly job. ETA 12 business days.

Kai: I'll grab representative traces. Which format do you want? I can export trace-v3 sanitized bundles. Also will coordinate staging infra for the 90m run.

Marta: trace-v3 sounds good. Please strip identifiers and PBIs. @Kai which bucket?

Kai: s3://incidents/io-eviction/2026-03-samples/ contains the two candidate traces. I'll run a scrub job and post links. ETA 36h.

Taylor: I'll own promptsets + eval metrics. Plan: produce two promptsets (short-context and long-context) plus an eval that checks correctness + latency regression. Acceptance: P95 latency <= 1.25x baseline, accuracy delta <= 0.5%. ETA 8 days.

Priya: I'll create a perf ticket and schedule the sustained load. Added: PERF-4892 "eviction-sustained-load-90m" assigned to @Priya, due in 14 days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PERF-4892

incident-bot: Ticket PERF-4892 created and associated with postmortem IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-harness-nightly` ready to be wired.

Sam: For chaos drills: tabletop first (20-30m) then a single controlled eviction run in staging. Marta to lead the live run, Kai to provision staging signals, Taylor to run evals during the run. I'll schedule the tabletop for Wednesday 16:00.

Marta: Suggested test filenames and labels so searches pick them up:
```
tests/eviction-suite/
  - eviction_replay_test.yaml    # deterministic incident replay
  - eviction_workingset_90m.yaml # sustained working set ramp
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","load","chaos"]
```

Marta: I'll open the harness PR with a quickstart and sample sanitized trace reference.

Taylor: I'll add eval-runner jobs `eviction/latency` and `eviction/correctness` and commit small golden outputs to compare.\n
Priya: Dependencies: sanitized traces from Kai, a temporary infra quota bump for the 90m run (infra scheduling), and additional CI minutes approval (finance). Noted in PERF-4892.

Kai: I'll post scrubbed trace links in the ticket and ping infra-schedule for quota. Scrub job should finish in ~36h.

Sam: Owner recap: Marta -> regression harness + chaos live; Taylor -> promptsets + eval baselines; Priya -> perf ticket + load orchestration; Kai -> traces + infra coordination; Sam -> tabletop + follow-up.

Marta: Checklist I'll maintain in the PR description: 1) harness + tests PR, 2) sanitized traces attached, 3) CI job wired, 4) perf ticket linked, 5) eval acceptance doc.

Taylor: I'll include small scripts to run the promptsets locally and example output.

Sam: Please drop firm ETAs into the PR checklist by EOD today so I can lock the drill date.

Priya: ETAs posted in PERF-4892 comments: Marta(12 days), Taylor(8 days), Kai(2 days), Priya(14 days), Sam(schedule this week).

incident-bot: CI job `eviction-harness-nightly` will run at 02:30 UTC daily after PR merge.

Marta: One more ask: add an alert automation. If eviction rate > 0.5% for 15m AND P99 tail > 1.8x baseline, auto-open an Ops breadcrumbs ticket. I'll draft the alert rule and add to alerts RFC.

Kai: Also recommend a synthetic monitor that asserts cache hit ratio on small keys every 5m and fires early if it drops > 10%.

Sam: Nice. I'll convert this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and link to PERF-4892 + the PRs. We'll confirm after the tabletop. :thumbsup:
